title: Border cell
description: This data pack makes survival more interesting. It’s a reimagining of the survival map set in the Barrier, but with unique mechanics and random elements-after all, the only pre-existing features here are the tree and the portal to the End.
body:
A unique project that completely transforms the standard game. (Inspired by the Captive Minecraft 1.11.2 mod), but it features unique elements, such as: random map generation (since it’s a mod), its own achievements, and a unique achievement system—for which all the original achievements were rewritten.
Enjoy the game!

P.S For other language expect english, install resoure pack, what pinned to datapack
